Proves AR-6's `notIn` operator on a `date` field (AR-7), with SEM-2's null-inclusion rule applying to the set-negative form. AG Grid's Set Filter has no exclude-mode wire shape, so this fixture uses the `customFilters` (OQ-11) extension point, as 036 and 038 do. Per SQL-4 Postgres casts the set array, `"birth_date" <> ALL($1::date[])`, because `date = text` does not exist (Bug #2304). Dates are local calendar dates with no zone (SEM-4): the neighbours one day either side of a member are not members.
